# Question 1 
```{r}
election_panel <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/election_panel_2000_2024.csv')
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(socviz)


election_panel <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/election_panel_2000_2024.csv"
)

election_panel$id <- as.character(election_panel$id)

map_data <- socviz::county_map %>%
  left_join(election_panel, by = "id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))


break_vals <- quantile(
  map_data$pct_DEMOCRAT,
  probs = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

label_vals <- c(
  paste0(round(break_vals[1], 1), " (Min)"),
  paste0(round(break_vals[2], 1), " (25th)"),
  paste0(round(break_vals[3], 1), " (Median)"),
  paste0(round(break_vals[4], 1), " (75th)"),
  paste0(round(break_vals[5], 1), " (Max)")
)

ggplot(map_data, aes(long, lat, group = group)) +

  geom_polygon(
    aes(fill = pct_DEMOCRAT),
    color = "grey80",
    size = 0.1
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#FFFFFF", "#211f82", "#81ABD9"),
    breaks = break_vals,
    labels = label_vals,
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "Percent Democrat",
    
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 15,   # makes scale longer
      barheight = 1
    )
  ) +

  coord_quickmap() +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 8),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#81ABD9",
      color = NA
    ),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10,
      color = "black"
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
    face = "bold",
    hjust = 0.5
  )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "U.S. Presidential Elections, 2000–2024",
    subtitle = "Votes toward Democratic Presidential Candidates"
  )
```
# Question 2 

```{r}
ny_income <- read_csv("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/NY_pinc_wide.csv")

p_title <- "Personal Income by County in New York"
p_caption <- "Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (https://www.bea.gov/data/income-saving/personal-income-by-county)"
```
```{r}
ny_counties_sf <- counties(state = "NY", year = 2024, cb = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
devtools::install_github("sjmgarnier/viridis")
install.packages(viridis)
library(viridis)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)


ny_income <- read_csv("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/NY_pinc_wide.csv") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pincp"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "income"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = str_remove(year, "pincp") |> as.integer(),
    income = as.numeric(income),
    fips = sprintf("%05d", fips)
  )


ny_counties_sf <- counties(state = "NY", year = 2024, cb = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf()


ny_map_df <- ny_counties_sf |>
  left_join(ny_income, by = c("GEOID" = "fips"))


p_title <- "Personal Income by County in New York"
p_caption <- "Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (https://www.bea.gov/data/income-saving/personal-income-by-county)"


ny_map_df |>
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = income)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", size = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(rainbow(7)),   
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Income",
    breaks = c(200000, 175000, 125000, 100000, 75000, 50000),
    labels = scales::dollar_format()(c(200000, 175000, 125000, 100000, 75000, 50000))
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colorbar(
      barheight = unit(18, "lines"),
      barwidth  = unit(0.6, "lines")
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = p_title,
    caption = p_caption
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

```
